<description>
This was added to work around `boost::filesystem` throwing when the environments locale was invalid. Boost.Filesystem has been removed, and `std::filesystem` doesn't use the locale on POSIX (and bitcoind never calls `setlocale`).

Qt calls `setlocale(LC_ALL, "")` on startup, and falls back to `C.UTF-8` if the locale isn't `UTF-8`.

Alternative to #36399, which extends the hack further.
</description>

<commits>
99837277b4 test: run GUI nodes in Dutch with -lang

This changes test behavior: GUI nodes now run with the Dutch
translation on all systems, also in CI. Before, they ran in English in
CI, because CI exports LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 and setdefault("LC_ALL",
"nl_NL.UTF-8") did nothing. So the translation check never ran there.

The old setting also fails when LC_ALL is not set and nl_NL.UTF-8 is
not installed: Qt prints a warning to stderr, and interface_gui.py fails
when SetupEnvironment() no longer replaces LC_ALL. -lang does not need
the locale to be installed. Date and number formats do not change.

27be7413e8 common: drop locale setting hack

This was added to work around `boost::filesystem` throwing when the
environments locale was invalid. Boost.Filesystem has been removed, and
`std::filesystem` doesn't use the locale on POSIX (and bitcoind never
calls `setlocale`).

Qt calls `setlocale(LC_ALL, "")` on startup, and falls back to C.UTF-8
if the locale isn't UTF-8.
</commits>
